name: Walking, Outdoor
instructions: Choose a route on pavement, a path, or a trail. Walk at a brisk pace with an upright posture, swinging your arms naturally and taking comfortable, even strides.
Maintain a pace fast enough to raise your heart rate while still being able to hold a conversation. Vary the terrain or add inclines to increase intensity.
A 150 lb person will burn about 150 calories walking briskly outdoors for 30 minutes, with variable terrain adding more challenge than a treadmill.
